recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Treat FHIR-6094 as historically applied and superseded by the later Patient|Group Condition.subject model; require a new current tracker for any present-day removal of Condition-subject.
issue_request: FHIR-6094 is a Published/Persuasive Patient Care issue asking to rename Condition's subject search parameter to patient because the resource still had subject; comments cite svn revision 5891.
initial_application: Git commit 584064415b304f98fd1074e03db8e78fba0dba2b, '#6094 - remove subject search parameter on Condition', applied the requested removal in 2015 while the element was Condition.patient.
additional_context: Later commit e35d3b3f92f11757466373e8b8f9f829d96d5cc9 changed the resource model back from Condition.patient to Condition.subject, broadened it to Reference(Patient|Group), and restored the subject search parameter while keeping patient. Current source defines Condition-patient as Patient-only and Condition-subject as the broader subject search. FHIR-31714 supports constrained patient targets, and the 2019 Zulip thread describes the same distinction.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. FHIR-6094 was applied historically, and the current subject search parameter is a later, intentional semantic addition rather than a missed application.
